title: Creamy Buffalo Chicken
description: Shredded chicken in a creamy cottage cheese and hot sauce mix, topped with cheese and grilled until bubbling. High protein and good the next day.

source.name: Social media post
source.note: Creator not recorded. Ingredient list from the post; Thermomix and air fryer method adapted in chat.

confidence.note: Ingredients from the source post. The method, Thermomix settings, air fryer settings and steaming time were adapted in chat and have not been test-cooked. Hot sauce quantity is to taste; the 2 tbsp starting point is an estimate.

nutrition.note: As stated by the source post; not checked. Likely assumes cooked chicken weight.

items.note: Source does not say whether this is raw or cooked weight
To taste. Frank's RedHot for classic buffalo flavour; Cholula also works but is less vinegary

steps.title: Chop the veg
steps.text: Chop the celery ({{celery}}) and onion ({{onion}}). Scrape down and set aside.

steps.title: Steam the chicken
steps.text: Add the water ({{water}}) to the bowl. Place the chicken ({{chicken}}) in the Varoma tray and steam until cooked through (75°C at the thickest point). Thicker breasts may need longer.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Empty the water. Add the chicken to the bowl and shred.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add the cottage cheese ({{cottage-cheese}}), hot sauce, garlic powder ({{garlic-powder}}) and the reserved celery and onion. Mix, then taste and adjust the hot sauce.

steps.title: Top with cheese
steps.text: Transfer to a small oven-safe dish that fits the air fryer basket. Top with the cheddar ({{cheddar}}).

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Air fry until golden and bubbling. The oven grill also works.

notes.title: Hot sauce
notes.text: Start with about 2 tbsp of Frank's and build from there.

notes.title: Smoother texture
notes.text: If you dislike cottage cheese curds, blend the cottage cheese on its own for 10-15 sec on Speed 6 before shredding the chicken.

notes.title: Air fryer chicken
notes.text: Instead of steaming, cook the chicken breast at 180°C for roughly 12-15 min, then shred in the Thermomix as above.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.
